            const pos = latLonToVec3(item.lat ?? 0, item.lon ?? 0, radius + 0.060);
            const isSel = item.id === selectedId;
            const markerTexture = loader.load((0, missionMarkers_1.getMissionMarkerUrl)(item.id));
            markerTexture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
            markerTextures.push(markerTexture);
            const pin = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
                map: markerTexture,
                color: isSel ? 0xe5ffff : 0xffffff,
                transparent: true,
                depthTest: true,
                depthWrite: false
            }));
            pin.scale.set(isSel ? .38 : .29, isSel ? .38 : .29, 1);
            pin.position.copy(pos);
            pin.userData = { id: item.id };
            scene.add(pin);
            pinMeshes.push(pin);
        });
        const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
        const pointer = new THREE.Vector2();
        let downPos = { x: 0, y: 0 };
        const onDown = (e) => {
            downPos = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
        };
        const onUp = (e) => {
            const dist = Math.hypot(e.clientX - downPos.x, e.clientY - downPos.y);
            if (dist > 6)
                return;
            const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
            pointer.x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
            pointer.y = -((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
            raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);
            const hits = raycaster.intersectObjects([...pinMeshes, sphere]);
            if (hits.length > 0 && hits[0].object !== sphere) {
                const hitId = hits[0].object.userData.id;
                const found = itemsRef.current.find(i => i.id === hitId);
                if (found)
                    onSelectRef.current(found);
            }
        };
        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown);
        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
        let frameId = 0;
        const animate = () => {
            frameId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        };
        animate();
        const onResize = () => {
            if (!container)
                return;
            const nw = container.clientWidth || 640;
            const nh = container.clientHeight || 360;
            camera.aspect = nw / nh;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(nw, nh);
        };
        window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);
        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener('resize', onResize);
            renderer.domElement.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onDown);
            renderer.domElement.removeEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
            cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
            controls.dispose();
            markerTextures.forEach(t => t.dispose());
            tex.dispose();
            renderer.dispose();
        };
    }, [body, items, selectedId]);
    return (0, jsx_runtime_1.jsx)("div", { ref: mountRef, className: "w-full h-full cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing" });
};

    const mix = Math.min(.48, dustLevel / 200);
    const material = (color, metalness = .55, roughness = .43, glass = false) => {
        const shade = new THREE.Color(color).lerp(dust, mix);
        return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
            color: xrayMode ? 0x39d3ee : shade,
            metalness: xrayMode ? .15 : metalness, roughness,
            transparent: xrayMode || glass,
            opacity: xrayMode ? .53 : glass ? .78 : 1,
            wireframe: xrayMode && !glass,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide
        });
    };
    const white = material(0xdfe3e1, .65, .4);
    const bright = material(0xf4f0df, .55, .4);
    const gray = material(0x828d92, .7, .35);
    const dark = material(0x30353a, .18, .8);
    const black = material(0x151f2d, .32, .47);
    const gold = material(0xbf8b3e, .65, .6);
    const foil = material(0xe1b35f, .7, .57);
    const blue = material(0x174c86, .42, .35);
    const cell = material(0x142c51, .34, .4);
    const lensMat = material(0x113b55, .08, .2, true);
    const copper = material(0x94592e, .75, .34);
    const rubber = material(0x343536, .1, .89);
    const coreMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe64e78, emissive: 0x8a183c, emissiveIntensity: xrayMode ? .8 : .06, metalness: .1, roughness: .5 });
    const add = (obj, parent = craft) => { parent.add(obj); return obj; };
    const box = (w, h, d, mat, pos, parent = craft) => {
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), mat);
        mesh.position.set(...pos);
        return add(mesh, parent);
    };
    const cylinder = (r, length, mat, pos, count = 20, parent = craft) => {
        const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r, r, length, count), mat);
        m.position.set(...pos);
        return add(m, parent);
    };
    const rod = (start, end, radius, mat, parent = craft, detail = 8) => {
        const a = new THREE.Vector3(...start), b = new THREE.Vector3(...end);
        const diff = b.clone().sub(a);
        const beam = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(radius, radius, diff.length(), detail), mat);
        beam.position.copy(a).add(b).multiplyScalar(.5);
        beam.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), diff.normalize());
        return add(beam, parent);
    };
    const ball = (r, mat, pos, parent = craft) => {

        mesh.position.set(...pos);
        return add(mesh, parent);
    };
    const panel = (w, d, pos, mount = craft, rows = 7, cols = 9) => {
        const group = add(new THREE.Group(), mount);

        box(w, .065, d, white, [0, 0, 0], group);
